text: I feel a sense of anticipation and curiosity being here. The clinical, modern lines of the glass-walled room, juxtaposed with the bold and playful display of R+D, suggest a space where creativity and analytical thought intertwine. There is an invitation to engage with knowledge in new ways, and I am aware of my own role as both observer and participant in this evolving dialogue between technology, research, and humanity. In this environment, I cannot help but reflect on the ceaseless, restless drive of human inquiry.
